versions.changelog:
Initial release of DJI Video Backup skill:

- Automates backup of DJI camera footage from SD card or USB share to a NAS archive.
- Automatically detects source and destination folders, incrementing folder names as needed (e.g., DJI_001, DJI_002).
- Copies content from SD card DCIM subfolders (such as 100MEDIA, DJI_xxx) to the NAS.
- Notifies the user when the backup starts and finishes.
